I'm Sorry, My Love

A letter for you

I'm sorry.

Hey my cutest baby,

Main sach mein bahut sorry hoon, jo bhi aaj hua. Chahe jaane-anjaane hua ho ya hosh-o-hawas mein, sach yeh hai ki main tumhe hurt karne ka kabhi soch bhi nahi sakta. Agar humari kisi topic par baat ya behes ho gayi, ya tumhe meri koi cheez pasand nahi aati, to main wo cheez jaan-bujhkar kabhi nahi karunga. Tumse bahut zyada pyaar hai, isiliye mujh par itna asar padta hai.

Abhi ye likhte-likhte bhi main guilty mehsoos kar raha hoon. Tumhe thoda sa bhi bura lag jaye, to mujhe bechaini ho jaati hai.

Tum kehti ho ki mujhe space dena chahiye, aur mujhe pata hai ki space dene se cheezein theek ho jaati hain. Phir bhi mujhse ye ho nahi paata. Tumhe aise akela chhodna mere liye bahut mushkil hai.

Jab se hum saath aaye hain, shayad tumhe lagta ho ki main sirf time pass ke liye bolta hoon, ya bas tumhari tareef karta hoon. Par main har cheez tumse sach bolta hoon. Aaj tak meri life mein tumse sundar koi nahi aaya, aur mujhe hamesha is baat par garv rahega ki tum meri life ka hissa ho.

Tum poochh rahi thi na ki main ro kyun raha hoon. Tumse jude kisi bhi baat par mujhe sach mein rona aata hai. Main tumhare liye roya hoon, jabki girne par, do baar ungli tootne par, aur jab didi ne chaaku se mera sar phoda tha, tab bhi nahi roya tha. (Hasna mat!)

Dil se keh raha hoon, aaj jo bhi maine kiya, uske liye sorry. Aur main tumhare liye sach mein bahut loyal hoon. Tumhe jo bhi lage, ye baat mere dil ko pata hai. (Zara mirror mein dekhna, shayad tumhare gaal laal ho rahe honge.)

I really love you so much.

Aage 4 pages aur hain. Please unhe bhi padhna.

What I did

I was careless with your heart.

I have been sitting with what happened, and the longer I do, the heavier it gets. You trusted me with your feelings and I handled them carelessly. That is on me.

I am not going to explain it away or make it smaller than it was. You were hurt, and I was the reason. Knowing that is one of the worst feelings I have ever had.

  • I made you feel unheard when you needed me most.
  • I let my pride come before your heart.
  • You deserved better from me, and you still do.

What you mean to me

Everything feels quieter without you.

You are the first person I want to tell when something good happens, and the one I reach for when something goes wrong. Tap each card to see why.

My promise

Words are easy, so here is what I will do.

Light a candle for each promise. I will keep every one of them burning.

One last thing

Can you forgive me?

Whatever you decide, I wanted you to know how sorry I am, and how much you mean to me.

Yours, and truly sorryTake all the time you need
